proof_body:
by
  intro p q P y₁ v₁ y₂ v₂ hP h₁ h₁' h₂ h₂' s t
  have hg : ∀ u, HasDerivAt (fun u => (y₁ u * v₂ u - v₁ u * y₂ u) * Real.exp (P u)) 0 u := by
    intro u
    have hW : HasDerivAt (fun u => y₁ u * v₂ u - v₁ u * y₂ u)
        (v₁ u * v₂ u + y₁ u * (-(p u * v₂ u) - q u * y₂ u) -
          ((-(p u * v₁ u) - q u * y₁ u) * y₂ u + v₁ u * v₂ u)) u :=
      ((h₁ u).mul (h₂' u)).sub ((h₁' u).mul (h₂ u))
    have h : HasDerivAt (fun u => (y₁ u * v₂ u - v₁ u * y₂ u) * Real.exp (P u))
        ((v₁ u * v₂ u + y₁ u * (-(p u * v₂ u) - q u * y₂ u) -
          ((-(p u * v₁ u) - q u * y₁ u) * y₂ u + v₁ u * v₂ u)) * Real.exp (P u) +
          (y₁ u * v₂ u - v₁ u * y₂ u) * (Real.exp (P u) * p u)) u :=
      hW.mul (hP u).exp
    exact h.congr_deriv (by ring)
  have hc : (y₁ t * v₂ t - v₁ t * y₂ t) * Real.exp (P t) =
      (y₁ s * v₂ s - v₁ s * y₂ s) * Real.exp (P s) :=
    is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun u => (hg u).differentiableAt) (fun u => (hg u).deriv) t s
  have hone : Real.exp (P t) * Real.exp (-P t) = 1 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
  have hE : Real.exp (P s - P t) = Real.exp (P s) * Real.exp (-P t) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1
  calc y₁ t * v₂ t - v₁ t * y₂ t
      = (y₁ t * v₂ t - v₁ t * y₂ t) * Real.exp (P t) * Real.exp (-P t) := by
        rw [mul_assoc, hone, mul_one]
    _ = (y₁ s * v₂ s - v₁ s * y₂ s) * Real.exp (P s) * Real.exp (-P t) := by rw [hc]
    _ = (y₁ s * v₂ s - v₁ s * y₂ s) * Real.exp (P s - P t) := by rw [hE, mul_assoc]
target_source: ∀ (p q P y₁ v₁ y₂ v₂ : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ t, HasDerivAt P (p t) t) → (∀ t, HasDerivAt y₁ (v₁ t) t) → (∀ t, HasDerivAt v₁ (-(p t * v₁ t) - q t * y₁ t) t) → (∀ t, HasDerivAt y₂ (v₂ t) t) → (∀ t, HasDerivAt v₂ (-(p t * v₂ t) - q t * y₂ t) t) → ∀ s t, y₁ t * v₂ t - v₁ t * y₂ t = (y₁ s * v₂ s - v₁ s * y₂ s) * Real.exp (P s - P t)
